title: Moesha
description:
S4 E3 — Hello! What’s This?
Dee finds a joint in the couch while cleaning the house.  Frank and Dee assume and accuse Mo, but Moesha is shocked when she catches Myles smoking.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E4 — Psyche Your Mind
Based on the family turmoil, the family begins counseling, but Moesha doesn’t want to air the family’s 'dirty laundry'.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E5 — Teacher
Moesha is attracted to a substitute teacher at Crenshaw. After they kiss, he leaves the school for 'personal reasons'.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E6 — I Know What You Did In The Third Grade
Moesha and her friends are stalked by a student who was just released from jail who they haven’t seen since the third grade when he got into trouble because of them.  Parody of Brandy’s feature 'I Still Know What You Did Last Summer…'.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E7 — A Terrible Thing Happened On My Tour Of College
Moesha and her friends are invited to a college to attend a Prospective Freshman Weekend and someone slips a 'roofie' in her drink.  Her boyfriend Aaron keeps her from being taken advantage of.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E19 — Whole Lotta Love Seat
When Eddie buys a new couch, he doesn't have enough money to pay the rent.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E20 — Swappin'
A mistakenly delivered love letter spawns romantic confusion at McGee's.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E21 — Retreat & Surrender
Malcolm, Eddie and their friends are stranded during their employee picnic and retreat.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E22 — Jingle Fever
After refusing an offer of a buyout, a big tow truck operator destroys Eddie's business.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E1 — Been There, Done That
Malcolm's good luck streak is matched bad Eddie's sudden run of bad fortune.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E2 — Roofless People
To fix a leaky roof, the bank loan officer forces Malcolm to hire his daughter.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E3 — Casino Evil
Stiff competition inspires Malcolm and Eddie to turn McGee's into a casino.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E7 — The Dowry
Fred's cousin and his new bride visit from St. Louis with the idea of finding a husband for his cousin's new stepdaughter. When Fred learns there's a $10,000 dowry involved, he schemes to get Lamont to ask for her hand in marriage.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E8 — Jealousy
Invited to dinner at the Sanford home, Fred's fiancée Donna brings along a patient who is in her care. Fred is shocked when the man, apparently a healthy specimen, makes it obvious he thinks of Donna as more than a nurse.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E9 — Tooth Or Consequences
When Fred's attempt to have a hypnotist cure his toothache fails, Lamont insists his 'chicken' father go to the free clinic. Resigned to his fate, Fred goes with Lamont, but it's Lamont who is in for the unexpected medical complication.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E10 — The Shoot Out
When Lamont brings home an antique gun, Fred pulls the trigger and is surprised to learn the gun was loaded. Fred has just had an argument with his neighbor Herman Goldstein and the bullet careens through Goldstein's window.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E11 — The Puerto Ricans Are Coming! The Puerto Ricans Are Coming!
Fred is upset because his new neighbor is opening a competing junkyard -- but he's beside himself when he learns the neighbor is Puerto Rican. Fred vows to remedy the situation, over the strong objections of Lamont, who has become Julio's friend.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E12 — A Visit From Lena Horne
Fred spots Lena Horne's car in the parking lot while touring the NBC Studios and sneaks away to meet 'the first lady of his dreams.' When there is no answer to the knock on Lena's dressing room door, Fred enters and inspects her personal belongings.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E13 — Sanford & Son & Sister Makes Three
Fred's old flame Juanita brings her daughter Alice to dinner and it's love at first sight for Lamont. Juanita discloses a very delicate and difficult situation when she tells Fred that Alice is really his daughter -- and Lamont is thus dating his sister.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E21 — Every Night Fever
An evening out at the disco turns into 'every night fever' when George stretches a good thing a bit too far. Louise's frustration grows when she realizes that she is to blame.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E22 — Three Faces Of Florence
Florence's efforts to make herself more 'interesting' backfire when her new suitor turns out to be a psychiatrist -- and 'interesting' Florence is one of the worst cases he's seen. George and Louise are worried over Florence's condition.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E23 — Louise's Convention
There's foul play afoot when George tries to duck out of celebrating his wedding anniversary with Louise and she tries to duck out of town to attend a convention.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E24 — The Freeze-In
When a sudden cold spell throws the Jeffersons, the Willises, Florence, and Mr. Bentley into one crowded apartment, the only things heating up are their tempers.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S2 E14 — Dream Lover
When Tia confides in Tamera that she dreamed of kissing "Stinky Steve," their boss at Rocket Burger, Steve mistakenly believes she's got "the hots" for him.
